column1: # TIME and DATETIME rules (ADR-0008 §4.2-§4.3). Format: see FactFixtures.kt.
# 24-hour forms: 13-23 and a leading-zero hour are unambiguous
# No marker, hour 1-12 without a leading zero: candidates (Q-5)
# Not time shapes: nothing at all
# Ranges: two separate times, each read from its own text (Z-05)
# A range abstains as a whole when the second time abstains under §4.3 (ZZ-03)
# Stated residual (ZZ-07): mixed-case zone words do not stop a time
# Date-times: both parts unambiguous, separated only by whitespace, ',', at, @, T or -
# Either part ambiguous: emitted separately, no cross-product
# Not a permitted separator: separate facts
# A zone abstains the time and the date-time; a separate date survives
# An invalid part does not hide the other
# A time range keeps its two times; the date stays a date
# Claimed by a time, so no phone
